html:
My latest novel in The Rho Agenda series, The Altreian Enigma, just went live in Australia. It will be released on Audible.com and on Amazon.com just after midnight Pacific time here in the U.S. Enjoy.

Best, Richard

comments.html: Just about finished with The Altreian Enigma…..fabulous addition to the tale!!! Actually got upset at one point when Jack made a huge choice….love these characters, the world you have created, and can’t wait to read more!!! There will be more????? SOON!!!! Lol!
